## What's Changed
* DROID-4602 Editor | Fix | An inline query with a type source opens the type screen by @konstantiniiv in https://github.com/anyproto/anytype-kotlin/pull/3365
* DROID-4603 Editor | Fix | Tab and Shift+Tab indent and outdent a block by @konstantiniiv in https://github.com/anyproto/anytype-kotlin/pull/3366
* DROID-4601 Editor | Fix | The editor fills the window on a tablet by @konstantiniiv in https://github.com/anyproto/anytype-kotlin/pull/3363
* DROID-4604 update mw to 0513 by @konstantiniiv in https://github.com/anyproto/anytype-kotlin/pull/3367


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/anyproto/anytype-kotlin/compare/0.50.3...0.50.4
